title: Kamui: Pocket Dimension
body:
Syntax: perform kamui [pocket dimension] <target|self|close>  |  kpocket close

Description: Cast on yourself to open and enter your own pocket dimension immediately. Or cast on a same-room target to send them there first, then cast on yourself to join them. Upkeep begins while the caster is inside and joins the six-minute summary. Only one dimension can be open per caster, and a player already inside another pocket dimension cannot be moved into a new one. Use 'perform kamui close' or 'kpocket close' from OUTSIDE or inside to immediately collapse YOUR dimension; every trapped player and mob returns to their original location. Other casters cannot close your dimension. Closing has no chakra charge and is available while the caster remains outside. A disconnect also collapses it. Paid maintenance can improve mastery even outside combat. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. The target must be in your room; moving away before a delayed cast resolves makes it fizzle. Costs 0 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 0 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
